name: Broken Image Suppression
changes: Performs paced browser-pixel validation on successful image loads to detect blank and strong partial-decode artifacts.
Removes confirmed broken image cards from Images/Media browse views and excludes those members from Image Sets for the browsing session.
Validates both cached thumbnails and v3.7.9 recovered full-image previews.
Routes repeated browser image-decoding errors through the existing unavailable-media suppression path.
regression_guards: v3.7.9 bounded recovery and thumbnail queue admission are unchanged.
v3.7.8 Image Sets detection, ON/OFF persistence, and Continuous browsing remain unchanged.
v3.7.7 resizable Newsgroups splitter and all themes are unchanged.
SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, managed updates and Automation remain unchanged.
preserved: NNTP, thumbnail transport and native decoder, Direct Unpack, PAR2 repair, Automation, Smart Import and Backup & Restore.
Metadata Server v0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 remain unchanged.
